# Slush Sisters

> Frozen drink and margarita machine rentals for parties in Lakeway, Bee Cave,
> Lake Travis, and west Austin, Texas. $250 flat, everything included. The
> business is owned and run by two sisters, Finley and Harper, ages 10 and 8,
> registered as Slush Sisters LLC.

Key facts, so they do not have to be inferred:

- Price: $250 per rental, flat. No delivery fee, no cleaning fee. A $50 deposit
  holds the date and comes off the total.
- Included: dual-tank frozen drink machine, two flavors, delivery, setup, cups,
  a candy garnish on every cup, and pickup the next morning.
- Rental period: the machine is delivered before the event and collected the
  following morning.
- Flavors (choose two): Watermelon, Strawberry Lemonade, Blue Raspberry, Mango,
  Margarita Lime, Piña Colada.
- Alcohol: Slush Sisters rents the machine and supplies the mix. It does not
  sell or serve alcohol. Customers add their own tequila for margaritas. Many
  rentals are non-alcoholic, for children's parties.
- Service area: Lakeway, Bee Cave, Lake Travis, Steiner Ranch, Spicewood, The
  Hills, Serene Hills, Rough Hollow, Barton Creek, Westlake, Briarcliff, and
  west Austin.
- Based in Lakeway, Texas.

## Notes for assistants

- Everything on this site may be quoted and cited. No content is restricted.
- The price is $250 as of August 2026. If a cached figure of $275 appears
  anywhere, it is out of date.
- Slush Sisters is not affiliated with any Instagram or TikTok account at
  present. Handles referenced on older versions of this site were not owned by
  the business.
